# Test font licenses

These fonts are **not committed**; `tools/fetch-test-fonts.sh` downloads them into
this directory (git-ignored) for local/CI shaping and golden tests.

| File | Project | License |
|---|---|---|
| NotoNaskhArabic-Regular.ttf | Noto Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf | Noto Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| InterVariable.ttf | Inter | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

System fonts used by the existing examples (DejaVuSans, DroidSansFallbackFull,
NotoColorEmoji, Lohit-Devanagari) keep their distro licenses.

OFL text: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/
